decisions.reason: The training programme builds directly on the firm's strong application know-how, training capability, and service network, so its absorptive capacity for refining and commercializing it is high.

As a rotary-axis accessory closely related to the firm's modular milling systems and installed base, it fits existing knowledge well and can be improved through customer feedback and in-house engineering.

Hybrid additive post-processing is the most distant from the firm's established core in high-speed machining and accessories, so despite solid R&D the firm is less likely to assimilate early market learning fast enough to justify continued commercialization.

A high-speed CNC milling machine product line sits at the center of the firm's accumulated technical knowledge, testing capability, and customer relationships, making continued support and iterative improvement highly likely.
An automatic tool change system strongly complements the firm's machinery portfolio and productivity promise, and the firm has the related engineering and application knowledge needed to sustain it.
